about_the_game:
Midautumn is now on Kickstarter! Please back and share our campaign!

This is a pre-alpha slice of gameplay, meant to serve as a proof of concept for the game's vision! It includes the game's first area and boss, as well as a sneak peek of the game's second area! On the Midautumn festival on the 21st of September, we will also be releasing a preview of the game's second boss for players to try and defeat! Enjoy your time exploring Nambo Quay, and practice your runs in anticipation of the final week of our Kickstarter, where we'll be holding a speedrun competition with a special grand prize! More details can be found in the Midautumn community discord!
